lines: Alright class, shut the fuck up and sit your asses down.
Today: shit facts nobody fucking asked for.
In nineteen thirty-two, Australia went to war with fucking emus. With machine guns.
And the goddamn emus won. Birds kicked their ass.
Lobsters pee out of their goddamn faces.
That's how they flirt. Nasty-ass bastards.
The guy who invented the fucking Pringles can?
His ashes are buried in one. Hell yeah.
Scotland's national animal is the goddamn unicorn.
A whole-ass country picked a horse that isn't even fucking real.
Koala fingerprints look almost exactly like yours. No bullshit.
A koala could frame your dumb ass for murder.
And sharks are older than trees.
Fucking trees! Sharks were here first, bitch.
